content.generalOverview: The guidelines focus on various interventions and considerations for aortic coarctation, aortic arch anomalies, and associated cardiovascular risks. It highlights studies related to surgical and interventional strategies for aortic coarctation repair, long-term outcomes, and risk assessments.

clinicalStudies.title: Coarctation of the aorta
clinicalStudies.description: Various studies on coarctation of the aorta highlight surgical and non-surgical interventions, their outcomes, and associated risks.

clinicalStudies.title: Aneurysm formation
clinicalStudies.description: Studies focus on aneurysm formation in patients with aortic coarctation and the implications for screening and management.

clinicalStudies.title: Genetic considerations
clinicalStudies.description: There are references to specific conditions with possible genetic links influencing presentation and repair strategies.

clinicalStudies.title: Thromboembolic events
clinicalStudies.description: Research describes the risk factors for stroke and thromboembolic events in left-sided heart conditions.

recommendations: Regular screening for aneurysms in patients with coarctation.
Consideration of family history and genetics in the planning of treatment strategies.
Cross-sectional imaging recommended for long-term follow-up.
